command: import hashlib,pathlib,urllib.request; p="experiments/gemini-3.5-flash-lite/2026-09-05-11-41-pm/plan.json"; u="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mnvsk97/PLaND/4ad24c9838922b3db777ac4ba4dbc34de7a449ae/"+p; r=urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=60); b=r.read(); assert hashlib.sha256(b).digest()==hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).digest(); print("PASS: unauthenticated public collection plan matches local SHA-256",hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())

command: import pathlib,subprocess; r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); status=subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],text=True); assert not status,status; assert not (r/"tmp").exists(); assert not (r/".env").exists(); print("PASS: isolated clean checkout",subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()); print("No source-workspace tmp directory or .env file; verification used a newly installed locked environment.")

reference-language-preservation-check
command: import json,subprocess,re; from pathlib import Path; p="experiments/gemini-3.5-flash-lite/2026-09-06-manuscript/paper-calculations.json"; before=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","5488a857:"+p])); after=json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); assert before==after; current=Path("paper/PLaND.md").read_text(); previous=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","5488a857:paper/PLaND.md"]).decode(); reference=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","4ad24c98:paper/PLaND.md"]).decode(); get=lambda text,name:re.search(r"<!-- audit:"+name+r" -->(.*?)<!-- /audit:"+name+r" -->",text,re.S).group(1); assert all(get(current,n)==get(previous,n) for n in ("repeat_table","interval_table","selection_table","final_table","development_table","mechanism")); headings=lambda text:re.findall(r"^#{2,3} .+$",text.split("## Appendix A")[0],re.M); assert headings(current)==headings(reference); assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","5488a857","--","paper/figures"]); print("PASS: entire numerical payload, all individual result tables, intervals, gate decisions, and figures unchanged; main section headings and order match September 5."); print(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--numstat","5488a857","--","paper/PLaND.md"]).decode()); print("September 5 comparison:"); print(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--numstat","4ad24c98","--","paper/PLaND.md"]).decode())
